## Disclaimer {.appendix .unnumbered}

This research presents a fictional case study of *BioBalance*, 
a company operating in the food-for-biodiversity sector. 
The associated brands, locations, and customers are entirely fictional and 
generated using AI. 
Although the time series analysis is based on real business data, every effort 
has been made to anonymize and protect sensitive information. 
Any resemblance to actual entities — past or present — is purely coincidental.

## Acknowledgments {.appendix .unnumbered}

I am deeply grateful to [**{{<var mentor>}}** ](https://www.tue.nl/en/education/professional-education/current-programs/eaisi-academy/lecturers/dr-ieke-le-blanc) for his insightful feedback and valuable guidance throughout this research. His emphasis on the importance of Forecast Value Added (FVA), as opposed to merely evaluating Statistical Forecast Accuracy, profoundly shaped the direction and depth of this book.

Additionally, he introduced me to [Nicolas Vandeput](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vandeputnicolas/), whose concise yet inspiring YouTube videos sparked key ideas central to the development of the *Pythia’s Advice project*, as can be seen in the chapters [Setting the Stage](#sec-setting-the-stage) and [Insight to Impact](#sec-insight-to-impact).

The guidance provided by {{<var mentor >}} significantly enhanced this study, helping me avoid numerous pitfalls. Any remaining errors or oversights are, of course, entirely my own responsibility.

## How to Read This Book

This guide will help you navigate through this book and make the most of its features.

### Book Structure

This structre of the book is shown in the sidebar on the left, which can be used for navigation:

-   **Preface**: disclaimer, acknowledgments and how-to read this book.
-   **Prophecy to Prediction**: the story behind the name *Pythia’s Advice*.
-   **Setting the Stage**: the inspiration behind the project.
-   **The Heart of Pythia**: the main research with a chapter per CRISP-DM phase.
-   **Insight to Impact**: how to use the Project's results to create impact.
-   **Appendix**: coding, references, and supplementary materials on each CRISP-DM phase.

### Navigation Features

This book includes several features to enhance your reading experience:

#### Table of Contents

- The *left sidebar* displays the full structure of the book. The top level shows 
the main Parts, with each Chapter listed beneath. The current chapter is 
highlighted. Click any chapter to navigate directly to it.

- The *right sidebar* shows the table of contents for the current chapter, allowing 
you to quickly jump to specific sections within it.

#### Search Function

Use the search icon (🔍) in the top navigation bar to search for specific terms throughout the book.

#### Page Navigation

To support a natural, linear reading experience, each chapter includes navigation links at the bottom that take you to the previous or next chapter.

#### Code Blocks

```{r}
#| echo:      true
#| output:    true
#| include:   true
#| warning:   true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Click to Show R Code"

x <- 41   # code line 1
x <- 42   # code line 2
```

-   Code blocks have a copy button (📋) in the top-right corner
-   Some code blocks can be expanded to show more details <!-- - You can also toggle between code and output views -->

#### Cross-References

This book contains cross-references — hover over them to get a sneak preview:

-   figures (@fig-01-bu-map)
-   definitions (@def-EX-DEF)\
-   chapters (@sec-01-business-understanding)

#### Interactive Elements

Some sections contain interactive elements:

-   Click on images to enlarge them\
<!-- -   Interactive visualizations allow you to explore data\ -->
-   Collapsible sections can be expanded for additional details

### Reading Pathways
1. All chapters — with the exception of **The Heart of Pythia**
— are optional. However, it is recommended to explore them first, as they provide essential background and context.

1.  The central chapter: **The Heart of Pythia**, lies at the heart of this book. 
Structured around the CRISP-DM methodology, it is designed to be read in a 
linear sequence, guiding the reader through each phase step by step. To enhance readability, this chapter contains no code and functions as a true white paper — concise in text, and supported by clear visuals and informative tables.

1.  The Appendix contains the corresponding code and detailed analysis for each 
CRISP-DM phase, e.g. @sec-11-business-understanding in the appendix for the 
related coding and details.

### Best Viewing Experience

For the optimal experience:

-   Use a modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge)\
-   Enable JavaScript for interactive features\
-   Use the dark/light mode toggle for your preferred reading environment

### Downloading and Sharing

-   Access the source code and data in GitHub with the github icon.
-   The pdf icon will open the book as a PDF.
-   In section @sec-19-resources the pptx and other resources can be locally saved(💾).
-   Use the share buttons to share specific chapters on social media.
